New models added: zai-org/GLM-4.5V, google/gemma-3-270m, tencent/Hunyuan-GameCraft-1.0
Changes in model usage statistics: updated numbers for models like openai/gpt-oss-20b, openai/gpt-oss-120b
Changes in Spaces: updated applications and new additions like Wan2.2 14B Fast, GPT-OSS-120B on AMD MI300X, Ovis2.5 9B
